description: Punti captazione uso potabile PdGPo 2021 (Distretto Po) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.adbpo.it. Representation of abstraction points for drinking use - Water Management Plan of the river basin district Po (PdGPo) 2021 (District Po). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water collection points PdGPo 2021 (District Po)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Regionale. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
